agent_discovery.description: Commit exactly one fresh Integrated Controller observation-path preview that has already received a separate decision-specific operator approval. The only model-supplied input is the authorization decision ID; coordinates, speeds, modes, contact permissions, leases, and fallback motions cannot be supplied or changed by the model.
when_to_use: A nonphysical observation path preview has been created and separately approved by the operator.
The OpenAI Agents SDK must select the final finite execution skill for that exact approved decision.
when_not_to_use: No approved decision-specific authorization record exists.
The preview, decision, controller identity, scene, or workcell evidence may be stale.
The task needs a new target, speed, controller mode, contact permission, lease change, safe-home, or fallback motion.
side_effects: Issues one signed, short-lived, one-time execution assertion for the approved decision.
Commits the exact recorded Integrated Controller preview and may physically move the robot.
Does not accept or derive any new motion parameter.

decision_id.description: Exact fresh operator-approved observation-motion decision ID.
